title: Q-90: CORE-1: Deploy platform/core to Cloud Run and verify live
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:docs/issues/Q-90.json::Status:\*\* closed
**Status:** closed

Migrated from GitHub issue 90 (Issues are off on the code repository; this file is the record).

code-task: repo=ultrastable path=platform/core/deploy/gcp/deploy.sh
Owner: founder (identity-bound: GCP project, billing, gcloud auth). After that the fleet runs the script.
Closing probe: `curl $URL/healthz` returns ok and `POST /tick` with the Secret Manager token returns 11/11 steps; record URL in HANDOFF.md. deploy.sh has never been run.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 222.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
